dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent circular 'O' and semi-circular 'C' structures exhibit a high-luminance white perimeter transitioning to a dark-grey interior. The perimeters are irregular and jagged, with some exhibiting thin bridge-like connections between adjacent rings.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid, low-intensity dark spots situated in the interstitial regions between macro-annuli. Occasional high-intensity white punctate spots are visible near the dorsal boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three large, centrally located annuli form an obtuse triangle. A cluster of four smaller annuli in the posterior-lateral region forms an irregular quadrilateral.

other_distinctive_markers: A thick, vertical high-contrast white band of varying pixel width is present near the posterior tail transition. Several thin, high-intensity linear features (likely vegetation) are superimposed over the lower mid-section.
